diagnosis: The developer portal API key details endpoint uses bun:sqlite to query the database by keyId without verifying that the key belongs to req.developer.id. Any registered developer on the platform can inspect API key scopes, rate limits, key prefixes, and metadata belonging to other developers and organizations.
exploit_request:
GET /api/developer/api-keys/key_live_fintech_prod_9918 HTTP/1.1
Host: developer.open-api.io
Authorization: Bearer dev_bearer_token_guest
